new_results.statement: For M=[[B,U],[V,D]] and the complete fixed-double-pair 3x3 extension bank H, H=||det(B)D-V adj(B)U||_F^2, without invertibility of B.
sqrt(H)<=(1/2)||B||_F||M||_F^2; hence some physical edge b in B satisfies |b|>=sqrt(H)/||M||_F^2.
For the symmetric physical principal pair on the forced edge, either max diagonal >=|b|/2 or the pair is indefinite with |det|>=3b^2/4 and sigma_min>=|b|/2.
In the conditioned-indefinite branch, either the exact post-pair Schur cross block has T2>=tau b^2 and the partner theorem pays the full form, or it lies in a rank-two Frobenius tube T2<tau b^2.
